findings.summary: Case status is rendered with a raw Material Chip instead of the shared MobileStatusPill, giving an inconsistent status treatment (color/shape/weight) versus the rest of the app.
findings.fix: Replace `Chip(label: Text(item.status))` with `MobileStatusPill(item.status)` (import mobile_widgets.dart), so status colors follow the shared status palette.

findings.summary: Hardcoded Colors.green for the 'already selected' check icon bypasses the theme and the shared status palette.
findings.fix: Use `Theme.of(context).colorScheme.primary` for the check icon, or the shared success color (0xFF0F9F6E), instead of `Colors.green`.

findings.summary: Appeal status is shown with a raw Chip rather than MobileStatusPill, inconsistent with how other statuses should appear.
Section titles are bespoke titleLarge Text widgets instead of the shared MobileSectionHeader used elsewhere, causing inconsistent section styling.
findings.fix: Render each section title via `MobileSectionHeader(title: ...)` so typography and spacing match other pages.

findings.summary: The error state is a bare centered Text with no icon, brand mark, or retry action, unlike a polished error state.
findings.fix: Wrap the error in a Card/Column with an error icon and a retry button that calls ref.invalidate(myDisputePortalProvider).

findings.summary: The empty state is a plain text Card with no icon or brand mark, giving a flat, unbranded empty experience for the primary list.
findings.fix: Add an illustrative icon (e.g. Icons.gavel_outlined) or BrandLogoMark and a secondary hint styled with onSurfaceVariant above the message.

findings.summary: Icon-only affordances (FloatingActionButton.extended and picker trailing icons) lack tooltips/Semantics for screen readers.
findings.fix: Add tooltip/Semantics labels to icon-bearing actions (e.g. the FAB and the picker's check/add trailing icons) so their purpose is announced.

findings.summary: The empty-state Card uses EdgeInsets.all(18) while every other card in the file uses all(16), an inconsistent padding value.
findings.fix: Use EdgeInsets.all(16) for the empty-state Card padding to match the other cards in this page.
